nodes.title: Solvency: Hansen screening
nodes.rationale: The existing solvency module is a concrete reuse candidate for a bounded compatibility screen; selection is proposed, not validated for these candidates.
nodes.method: Use the standalone Hansen solvency screen on declared polymer/solvent parameters.
procedure: Verify polymer/solvent identity, material state and parameter provenance (proposed integration prerequisite).
hansen_ra_squared rejects non-finite or negative dispersion, polar and hydrogen-bond parameters.
Compute Ra squared = 4*(dispersion difference)^2 + (polar difference)^2 + (hydrogen-bond difference)^2.
hansen_red rejects a non-finite or non-positive polymer interaction radius R, then computes RED = sqrt(Ra squared)/R.
The source comments interpret RED < 1 as predicted compatible and RED > 1 as predicted incompatible. Boundary handling and candidate-domain applicability still require review.
Retain the parameter provenance and applicability finding alongside the screen; a calculated RED is not measured compatibility.
outputs: Proposed compatibility screen and applicability findings
nodes.applicability: The v1 mission describes linear/uncured polymer fixture coverage. Applicability to the proposed novel candidates remains unestablished.
assumptions: The required parameters can be obtained for each proposed candidate.
The candidate material state falls inside the reviewed model domain.
nodes.rule: Use as a screening constraint within its reviewed domain. Do not promote a score to wet-lab compatibility or bioavailability.
nodes.evidence: Execution results are linked separately by exact node, artifact and schema identities; the plan does not assert their outcome.
nodes.availability: Registered v2 Hansen tool; explicit candidate execution bindings retained with this plan.
alternatives: Request a compatibility measurement when model applicability is unsupported.
Select another reviewed model with suitable domain evidence.
